about: Nightly totals from the City of Toronto's Daily Shelter & Overnight Service Occupancy & Capacity data. headline = every PROGRAM_AREA except Temporary Programs, COVID-19 Response and Temporary Refugee Response; temporary = Temporary Programs and, before 2024, COVID-19 Response (relabelled Temporary Programs on 2024-01-01); refugee = Temporary Refugee Response. Capacity is actual capacity. Beds and rooms are separate and never added. See docs/DATA.md.

turnaways.about: Central Intake Service Queue Data: 'Total individuals who were not able to be offered a space over the past 24 hours, at time of closeout at 4am.' Singles and couples only.
